name: Human Creativity in the Age of AI

mentions.name: Human Creativity in the Age of AI
mentions.description: A conference talk accompanied by a custom-built musical and visual contraption that drove the presentation, including a guitar solo generator that recuts phrases of the author's own playing into a new solo on the fly. The talk was also edited into a full video and short clips using DaVinci Resolve, with help from Codex.
mentions.source_excerpt: It was titled "Human Creativity in the Age of AI" (which I later learned was an unfortunately generic title, lol), and I built this whole big musical and visual contraption that drove the presentation, including a "guitar solo generator" which recuts phrases of my own playing into a new solo on the fly.
mentions.author: epiccoleman
